biography.text: Born in 1963 in Jersey City. Arleo received a B.A. (1985) and M.A. (1986) from Rutgers University and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1989). She clerked for New Jersey Supreme Court Justice Marie L. Garibaldi, practiced in Newark, and served as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2000 to 2014. President Barack Obama nominated her. She has served on the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation since 2021.
